description: Mirror of ping_pong_then_dead_peer_timeout.json from the CLIENT's perspective: the server never answers any of the client's own pings, and the client's keepalive watchdog fires. OVERVIEW.md section 2.9 Keepalive: measured from last_pong_received (here, welcome time, since no pong ever arrives), watchdog fires once elapsed strictly exceeds ping_timeout. welcome uses the wire floor values (ping_interval 30000ms, ping_timeout 90000ms, i.e. exactly 2x, per section 2.7's welcome field table). wait_ms (95000) is plain protocol time: past ping_timeout (90000ms) plus margin for the watchdog's own poll granularity.
